title: A fermata on a whole note
description: One whole-note G4 with an event-level fermata carrying both optional refinements: symbol normal (the ordinary arc-and-dot) and duration long (a performance hint from the veryShort-to-veryLong enum). Fermatas can also sit on global measures and full-measure rests; the event form is the common case. The renderer does not draw fermatas yet — the golden pins the bare note and is the golden that moves when they land.
